messages.subject: multiple text inputs
parts:
I am trying to create a shiny app that has multiple text inputs.  Here is how I've structured the first part of my server code but I continue to receive "Passing functions to 'reactive' is deprecated".  Any help would be appreciated. 

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
    
  updatedSymbol1 <- reactive({
    input$sym
    isolate(input$symbol1)
  })
  updatedSymbol2 <- reactive({
    input$sym
    isolate(input$symbol2)
  })

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: multiple text inputs
parts:
That means you have this somewhere:
  reactive(function() {
    ...
  })

That's how the first versions of Shiny wanted reactive() to work. In recent versions of Shiny, the function() part is deprecated, so this is what you should use:
  reactive({
    ...
  })


-Winston
